कुञ्ज

KUÑJA . A reputed sage. Once he enjoyed the company of pramlocā, the celestial woman. (See under pramlocā).

कुञ्जल १

KUÑJALA I . A warrior of skanda. (śalya Parva. Chapter 45).

कुञ्जल २

KUÑJALA II . A wise parrot which lived on the banks of the river narmadā. The padma purāṇa (Chapter 85, Bhūmikhaṇḍa) has the following to say about the parrot.

kuñjala, the wise parrot, had a wife and four sons called Ujjvala, Samujjvala, vijvala and Kapiñjala. These brothers used to feed themselves on sweet fruits etc. on the planes, mountains and other places. They also used to carry tasty fruits to their parents. The four brothers thus led a happy life in every way. (See under subāhu).

कुञ्जर १

KUÑJARA I . A great monkey. añjanā mother of hanūmān was the daughter of kuñjara. (vālmīki rāmāyaṇa, kiṣkindhā Kāṇḍa; Canto 66, Verse 9).

कुञ्जर २

KUÑJARA II . A well-known serpent. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 35, Verse 15).

कुञ्जर ३

KUÑJARA III . A prince of the Sāuvīra country. He was a follower of jayadratha, and was killed by arjuna. (Vana Parva, Chapter 271).
